title: INSPECTION PROCEDURE

AT1-89
AT340E (2JZ-GE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION – TROUBLESHOOTING

INSPECTION PROCEDURE
O/D OFF indicator light does not light up.

1 Check operation of O/D main switch.

ON
OFF ON
O/D button O/D OFF Indicator Light O/D Main Switch Point
Push in O/D OFF OFF
Push out O/D OFF ON
BE6653 G04238
AT5623

C 1. Turn ignition switch ON.
2. Check "O/D OFF" indicator light when O/D main switch is pushed in to ON.

OK "O/D OFF" indicator light goes off.

C 3. Check "O/D OFF" indicator light when O/D main switch is pushed again, to OFF.

OK "O/D OFF" indicator light lights up.

Hint If the "O/D OFF" indicator light blinks when the O/D main switch is pushed in to ON, a malfunction is occurring in the system.
Check the diagnostic trouble code.

OK
NG Go to step 4 .

2 Check voltage between terminal OD2 of ECM connector and body ground.

ON
Check Harness A
ECM
A 28 OD2
BE6653
AT8773

P 1. Connect the Check Harness A to the ECM (See page EG-404).
2. Turn ignition switch ON.

C Check voltage between terminal OD2 of the ECM and body ground.

OK
O/D Main Switch | Voltage
OFF | Below 3 V
ON | 9 – 14 V

NG
OK Proceed to next circuit inspection shown on matrix chart (See page AT1-58).

3 Check harness and connecter between O/D off indicator light and ECM (See page IN-30).

OK
NG Repair or replace harness or connector.

Check and replace ECM.
